---
title: "Field map"
page-layout: full
title-block-banner: true
output-file: index.html
format:
  html:
    # embed-resources: false -> ship deps (Leaflet libs, field_*.js, icons) as
    # separate SW-cached files beside index.html instead of inlining ~20 MB into
    # one file. render_push.sh copies them all. Rollback: set back to true.
    embed-resources: false
    include-in-header:
      # Quarto emits user-scalable=yes, which lets a stray two-finger touch zoom
      # the whole PAGE: the fixed bottom bar then sits outside the visual
      # viewport and the map looks full-screen. This meta lands later in <head>
      # and wins. The map's own pinch-zoom is Leaflet's, and is untouched.
      text: |
        <link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="icons/favicon.png">
        <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover">
---

```{r}
#| echo: false

# Inline the host-page CSS, read fresh each render (embedded, so no browser can
# serve a stale cached stylesheet).

htmltools::tags$style(
  htmltools::HTML(
    paste(
      c(
        readLines(here::here("outputs/nest_app_api/src/css/field_map_app.css")),

        # Concealment-screen sizing: the built CSS never got these rules, so the
        # live camera preview rendered at native (huge) resolution. Cap it.

        ".conceal-live-wrap { position: relative; width: 100%; }",
        ".conceal-video { display: block; width: 100%; max-height: 55vh;",
        "  object-fit: cover; background: #000; border-radius: 8px;",
        "  border: 1px solid var(--border, #ccc); }",
        ".conceal-live-overlay { position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 8px;",
        "  pointer-events: none; }",
        ".conceal-live-bearing { font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 700;",
        "  color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8); }",

        # Nest-page location photo: the built CSS uses object-fit:cover, which
        # CROPS the image. Show the whole photo (contain), tappable to a
        # full-screen view.

        ".nest-info-photo-img { width: auto !important; height: auto !important;",
        "  max-width: 100% !important; max-height: 60vh !important;",
        "  object-fit: contain !important; margin: 0 auto !important;",
        "  cursor: zoom-in; }"
      ),
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

source(here::here("outputs/nest_app_api/src/r/make_field_map.R"))

map_tracking
```

```{=html}
<!-- Phase 1 data/shell decoupling: load the externalized map-data payloads.
     These run after the embedded window.field* assignments above (identical
     data, harmless overwrite) and before field_map_app.js / map_weather.js
     consume the globals. -->
<script src="field_patches.js"></script>
<script src="field_icons.js"></script>
<script src="field_offline_tiles.js"></script>
<script src="field_data.js"></script>
```

```{=html}
<!-- API client layer (window.NestApi.*). Loaded BEFORE the main app IIFE so the
     concatenated app modules can call NestApi.settings / api / store / queue /
     sync at run time. Concatenation order among these five does not matter
     (each hangs one piece off the shared namespace, calling siblings lazily),
     but all five must run before the IIFE below. -->
<script src="src/js/nestapi_settings.js"></script>
<script src="src/js/nestapi_store.js"></script>
<script src="src/js/nestapi_client.js"></script>
<script src="src/js/nestapi_queue.js"></script>
<script src="src/js/nestapi_sync.js"></script>
```

```{=html}
<!-- Portrait lock: on a phone in landscape this covers everything and asks the
     user to rotate. The app is designed for portrait use only. -->
<div id="rotateNotice" class="rotate-notice">
  <div class="rotate-notice-inner">
    <div class="rotate-notice-icon">&#x21BB;</div>
    <div>Please rotate your device to portrait.</div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Waypoint navigation: a top banner (target / distance / bearing + Cancel)
     while navigating, and a centered "You have arrived!" popup. -->
<div id="navBanner" class="nav-banner" hidden>
  <div class="nav-banner-info">
    <span id="navTarget" class="nav-banner-target">&mdash;</span>
    <span class="nav-banner-stats">
      <span id="navDist">-- m</span> &middot; <span id="navBrg">--&deg;</span>
    </span>
  </div>
  <button type="button" id="navCancelBtn" class="nav-banner-cancel">Cancel</button>
</div>

<div id="navArrived" class="nav-arrived" hidden>
  <div class="nav-arrived-box">
    <div class="nav-arrived-title">You have arrived!</div>
    <div id="navArrivedName" class="nav-arrived-name"></div>
    <button type="button" id="navArrivedCancel" class="field-button">
      Cancel navigation
    </button>
  </div>
</div>
```

<!-- Menu overlay: holds several screens; only the .is-active one is shown.
     The bottom bar (a sibling, further down) stays visible on every screen.
     Each screen is a Quarto fenced div; its form controls -- buttons, inputs,
     selects, toggle switches -- have no Markdown equivalent, so they stay as
     raw HTML inside `{=html}` blocks. -->
     
:::: {#fieldMenuOverlay .field-menu-overlay}

::: {.field-screen .is-active data-name="main"}
```{=html}
    <div class="field-menu-panel">
      <!-- Patch filter: choose a patch to show only features within 50 m of it.
           Options are populated from the patch names by field_map_app.js.
           The "Patch" label text is omitted -- context makes it obvious. -->
      <label class="field-field-label">
        <select id="patchSelect" class="field-patch-select">
          <option value="__all__">All patches</option>
        </select>
        <button type="button" id="patchPickerBtn" class="field-input field-patch-picker-btn">All patches</button>
      </label>

      <div class="field-tilegrid">
        <div class="field-tile-cell">
          <button type="button" class="field-tile" data-screen="mapoptions">
            <img class="field-tile-icon" src="icons/gear.svg" alt="">
          </button>
          <span class="field-tile-label">Map options</span>
        </div>
        <div class="field-tile-cell">
          <button type="button" class="field-tile" data-screen="addwaypoint">
            <img class="field-tile-icon" src="icons/waypoint.svg" alt="">
          </button>
          <span class="field-tile-label">Add waypoint</span>
        </div>
        <div class="field-tile-cell">
          <button type="button" class="field-tile" data-screen="tracks">
            <img class="field-tile-icon" src="icons/tracks.svg" alt="">
          </button>
          <span class="field-tile-label">Add track</span>
        </div>
        <div class="field-tile-cell">
          <button type="button" class="field-tile" data-screen="nests">
            <img class="field-tile-icon" src="icons/nest_active.png" alt="">
          </button>
          <span class="field-tile-label">Nests</span>
        </div>
        <div class="field-tile-cell">
          <button type="button" class="field-tile" data-screen="waypointmgr">
            <img class="field-tile-icon" src="icons/waypoints.svg" alt="">
          </button>
          <span class="field-tile-label">Waypoint manager</span>
        </div>
        <div class="field-tile-cell">
          <button type="button" class="field-tile" data-screen="trackmgr">
            <img class="field-tile-icon" src="icons/track_manager.png" alt="">
          </button>
          <span class="field-tile-label">Track manager</span>
        </div>
        <div class="field-tile-cell">
          <button type="button" class="field-tile" data-screen="schedule">
            <img class="field-tile-icon" src="icons/calendar.svg" alt="">
          </button>
          <span class="field-tile-label">Schedule</span>
        </div>
        <div class="field-tile-cell">
          <!-- Concealment photos are captured in the standalone Concealment
               Camera app (native iOS): it locks focus at ~1 m and stamps the
               compass bearing, neither of which the web camera can do, and it
               now also owns nest selection (live GPS nearest-nest, manual
               override, artificial-nest tie-break). So this tile hands off to
               it directly via its deep link -- no intermediate screen -- see
               the concealLaunchTile handler in field_map_app.js. -->
          <button type="button" class="field-tile" id="concealLaunchTile">
            <img class="field-tile-icon" src="icons/my_camera.png" alt="">
          </button>
          <span class="field-tile-label">Concealment photos</span>
        </div>
        <div class="field-tile-cell">
          <button type="button" class="field-tile" data-screen="speciesinfo">
            <img class="field-tile-icon" src="icons/bunting.png" alt="">
          </button>
          <span class="field-tile-label">Species info</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
```

::: {.field-screen data-name="addwaypoint"}
```{=html}
    <div class="field-menu-panel">
      <div class="field-menu-title">Add waypoint</div>

      <!-- Live position + heading + (averaging) accuracy. -->
      <div class="field-live-readout">
        <div>Longitude: <span id="wpLon">--</span></div>
        <div>Latitude: <span id="wpLat">--</span></div>
        <div>Bearing: <span id="wpBrg">--</span></div>

        <!-- Sample confidence: empty = poor accuracy, grows to the right (and
             shifts red -> dark green) as the averaged estimate improves. -->
        <div class="field-conf">
          <div class="field-conf-head">
            <span class="field-conf-title">Sample confidence</span>
            <span class="field-conf-stats">
              <span id="wpTimer">00:00</span> &middot;
              <span id="wpSamples">0 samples</span>
            </span>
          </div>
          <div class="field-conf-track">
            <div class="field-conf-fill" id="wpAccBar"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="field-conf-foot">
            Spatial accuracy: <span id="wpAccLabel">--</span> meters
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <label class="field-field-label">Class
        <select id="wpClass" class="field-input">
          <option>Nest</option>
          <option>Landmark</option>
          <option>Path crossing</option>
          <option value="Boundary">Boundary marker</option>
          <option>Other</option>
          <option>Temp</option>
        </select>
      </label>

      <label class="field-field-label">Name
        <span class="field-name-input">
          <span id="wpNamePrefix" class="field-name-prefix"></span>
          <input type="text" id="wpName" class="field-input"
                 placeholder="Waypoint name" autocomplete="off">
        </span>
      </label>

      <label class="field-field-label" id="wpNoteField">Note
        <textarea id="wpNote" class="field-input" rows="3"
                  placeholder="Describe the waypoint"></textarea>
      </label>

      <div id="wpPhotoField">
        <label class="field-field-label">Photo
          <!-- No `capture` attribute: the OS offers Take Photo *or* Choose File. -->
          <input type="file" id="wpPhoto" class="field-input" accept="image/*">
        </label>
        <div id="wpPhotoPreview" class="field-photo-preview"></div>
      </div>

      <div class="field-field-label">Marker color</div>
      <!-- Color swatches (ROYGBIV) are injected by field_map_app.js. -->
      <div id="wpColorRow" class="field-color-row"></div>

      <div class="field-waypoint-actions">
        <button type="button" id="addWaypointSaveBtn" class="field-button">
          Save waypoint
        </button>
        <button type="button" id="addWaypointCancelBtn"
                class="field-button field-button--danger">
          Cancel
        </button>
      </div>

      <div id="addWaypointStatus" class="field-status" role="status"
           aria-live="polite"></div>
    </div>
```
:::

::: {.field-screen data-name="nestdata"}
```{=html}
    <div class="field-menu-panel">
      <div class="field-menu-title">Nest discovery data</div>

      <!-- Auto-filled from the saved GPS point; not editable here. -->
      <div class="field-nest-auto">
        <div>Nest ID: <span id="ndNestId" class="field-nest-auto-val">--</span></div>
        <div>GPS point: <span id="ndGpsPoint" class="field-nest-auto-val">--</span></div>
        <div>Discovery date: <span id="ndDiscoveryDate" class="field-nest-auto-val">--</span></div>
      </div>

      <div class="field-field-label">Patch</div>
      <!-- Defaults to the site (Long Branch / Snedgen Park) or closest patch. -->
      <select id="ndPatchId" class="field-patch-select"></select>
      <button type="button" id="ndPatchBtn"
              class="field-input field-patch-picker-btn">Patch</button>

      <div class="field-field-label">Species</div>
      <!-- Single-select via the large picker; options injected by JS. -->
      <select id="ndSpecies" class="field-patch-select"></select>
      <button type="button" id="ndSpeciesBtn"
              class="field-input field-patch-picker-btn">Choose species</button>
      <label class="field-field-label field-other-label" id="ndSpeciesOtherField"
             style="display:none;">Other species
        <input type="text" id="ndSpeciesOther" class="field-input"
               placeholder="Type the species" autocomplete="off">
      </label>

      <div class="field-field-label">Discovery stage</div>
      <select id="ndDiscoveryStage" class="field-patch-select">
        <option value="">— select —</option>
        <option>Building</option>
        <option>Incubation</option>
        <option>Nestling</option>
        <option>Inactive</option>
      </select>
      <button type="button" id="ndDiscoveryStageBtn"
              class="field-input field-patch-picker-btn">— select —</button>

      <label class="field-check-line">
        <input type="checkbox" id="ndSelfieStick"> Selfie stick used
      </label>
      <label class="field-check-line">
        <input type="checkbox" id="ndArtificialCandidate"> Artificial nest candidate
      </label>

      <div class="field-field-label">Camera or control</div>
      <select id="ndCameraOrControl" class="field-patch-select">
        <option>Control</option>
        <option>Camera</option>
      </select>
      <button type="button" id="ndCameraOrControlBtn"
              class="field-input field-patch-picker-btn">Control</button>
      <label class="field-field-label" id="ndCameraDateWrap" style="display:none;">
        Camera deployment date
        <input type="date" id="ndCameraDeploymentDate" class="field-input">
      </label>

      <label class="field-field-label">Height (m)
        <input type="number" id="ndHeight" class="field-input" step="0.1" min="0"
               inputmode="decimal" placeholder="e.g. 1.5" autocomplete="off">
      </label>

      <div class="field-field-label">Substrate</div>
      <!-- Multi-select via the large picker; options injected by JS. -->
      <select id="ndSubstrate" class="field-patch-select" multiple></select>
      <button type="button" id="ndSubstrateBtn"
              class="field-input field-patch-picker-btn">Choose substrate</button>
      <label class="field-field-label field-other-label" id="ndSubstrateOtherField"
             style="display:none;">Other substrate
        <input type="text" id="ndSubstrateOther" class="field-input"
               placeholder="Type the plant" autocomplete="off">
      </label>

      <!-- No dictate button: the app ships in a WKWebView, which exposes
           webkitSpeechRecognition but cannot grant it permission, so the button
           silently did nothing. The keyboard's own mic key dictates into this
           field on both iOS and Android. -->

      <label class="field-field-label">Location description
        <textarea id="ndLocationDescription" class="field-input" rows="3"
                  placeholder="Describe how to find this nest"></textarea>
      </label>

      <!-- The Note belongs to the WAYPOINT, so it stays add-flow only and is
           hidden when editing an existing nest's discovery row. -->
      <div id="ndWaypointFields">
        <label class="field-field-label">Note
          <textarea id="ndNote" class="field-input" rows="3"
                    placeholder="Other notes"></textarea>
        </label>
      </div>

      <!-- Both photos belong to the NEST, so they sit OUTSIDE #ndWaypointFields
           and show when modifying an existing nest as well as when adding one.
           The file inputs are hidden and driven by the buttons: a bare file
           input renders as the OS's own small "Choose File" chrome, which reads
           as nothing at all on a phone. No `capture` attribute, so the OS still
           offers Take Photo *or* Choose File. -->
      <div>
        <button type="button" id="ndPhotoBtn" class="field-button">
          Add/replace nest location photo
        </button>
      </div>
      <input type="file" id="ndPhoto" accept="image/*" style="display:none;">
      <div id="ndPhotoPreview" class="field-photo-preview"></div>

      <div>
        <button type="button" id="ndInsidePhotoBtn" class="field-button">
          Add/replace nest photo
        </button>
      </div>
      <input type="file" id="ndInsidePhoto" accept="image/*" style="display:none;">
      <div id="ndInsidePhotoPreview" class="field-photo-preview"></div>
      <div id="ndInsidePhotoExisting" class="field-status" style="display:none;"></div>

      <div class="field-waypoint-actions">
        <button type="button" id="nestDataSaveBtn" class="field-button">
          Save nest data
        </button>
        <button type="button" id="ndReRecordGps" class="field-button"
                style="display:none;">
          Re-record GPS
        </button>
        <button type="button" id="ndDeleteBtn"
                class="field-button field-button--danger" style="display:none;">
          Delete nest data
        </button>
        <button type="button" id="nestDataCancelBtn"
                class="field-button field-button--danger">
          Cancel
        </button>
      </div>

      <div id="nestDataStatus" class="field-status" role="status"
           aria-live="polite"></div>
    </div>
```
:::

```{r}
#| echo: false

# Inline the custom nest-marker PNGs as data URIs so the API-nest overlay
# (nestapi_map.js) can use the study's real icons in the self-contained build
# (no separate asset path). Only the current-nest icons are needed here.

nest_icon_files <-
  c(
    nest_active_eggs       = "nest_active_eggs.png",
    nest_active_nestlings  = "nest_active_nestlings.png",
    nest_artificial        = "nest_artificial.png",
    nest_inactive          = "nest_inactive.png",
    nest_failed_eggs       = "nest_failed_eggs.png",
    nest_failed_nestlings  = "nest_failed_nestlings.png",
    nest_failed_artificial = "nest_failed_artificial.png"
  )

nest_icon_json <-
  nest_icon_files %>%
  purrr::imap_chr(
    \(.file, .id) {
      uri <-
        xfun::base64_uri(here::here("outputs/nest_app_api/icons", .file))
      stringr::str_c('"', .id, '":"', uri, '"')
    }
  ) %>%
  stringr::str_flatten(collapse = ",")

htmltools::tags$script(
  htmltools::HTML(
    stringr::str_c("window.fieldNestIcons = {", nest_icon_json, "};")
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

# Inline the host-page JS at the end of the body (after the menu elements
# above exist). Embedded, so never cached stale.

htmltools::tags$script(
  htmltools::HTML(
    paste(
      c(
        "(function () {",
        "function init() {",
        readLines(here::here("outputs/nest_app_api/src/js/page_navigation.js")),
        readLines(here::here("outputs/nest_app_api/src/js/data_entry.js")),
        readLines(here::here("outputs/nest_app_api/src/js/image_annotate.js")),
        readLines(here::here("outputs/nest_app_api/src/js/field_map_app.js")),
        readLines(here::here("outputs/nest_app_api/src/js/nestapi_map.js")),
        "}",
        "if (document.readyState === \"loading\") {",
        "  document.addEventListener(\"DOMContentLoaded\", init);",
        "} else {",
        "  init();",
        "}",
        "})();"
      ),
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
)
```

# live change feed. Runs after page_glue so window.NestApi.* and the app IIFE
# functions it re-renders through are already defined. All effects are gated on

# before (baked Sheets/Drive data path).

)
